verdict.rationale: Recurly documents per-subscription changes to plan, price, quantity, or add-ons, with control over timing and proration. That covers moving an individual subscriber to new pricing, but the evidence never addresses plan versioning, explicit grandfathering of existing subscribers, or bulk tools for migrating cohorts. Missing for 10: versioned plans, documented grandfathering behavior when plan prices change, bulk/cohort subscription migration tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
